newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong June domestic exports off 14 pct on year.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong June domestic exports off 14 pct on year.

text.p: The volume of domestic exports in June fell 14 percent on year and re-exports decreased by 1.4 percent, Census and Statistics Department data showed.
Total export volume fell 3.7 percent and import volume decreased by 2.0 percent.
Volume of domestic exports for the first half of 1996 decreased by 8.2 percent while volume of re-exports leapt 6.9 percent. Total exports rose 4.3 percent and imports grew by 3.7 percent.
Prices of domestic exports rose 0.7 percent in June 1996 from a year earlier. Re-export prices decreased by 0.9 percent and import prices fell by 2.4 percent.
Prices of domestic exports for the first half of 1996 were 1.2 percent higher and re-exports rose 0.4 percent while import prices fell 0.2 percent.

Prices are based on unit values which do not take into account changes in the composition or quality of goods traded, except for some selected commodities for which specific price indices are available.
